A later Jira comment explicitly deferred adding doNotPerform for this issue because no use case had been identified at that time.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies SVN/Git commit 5115fa663f21d8c8f129b16f5c5f3b4ed2796bfd as the implementation for the bundled FHIR-14020/FHIR-14021/FHIR-14022 workflow family. For MedicationRequest, that commit updated the old spreadsheet source by changing definition to instantiates, adding statusReason, performerType, insurance, workflow Request mappings, and removing the old requester.agent/onBehalfOf shape. The follow-up b22fbdaff11417e468a75c0657ffec6170e99c1f build-fix commit made only a MedicationRequest punctuation wording fix while continuing the same family application.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is still active in the current build. The source has been refactored from spreadsheet input into source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml, which now declares the workflow mapping space, maps MedicationRequest to Request, and carries the aligned Request mappings. Later Pharmacy work, including FHIR-15941 for doNotPerform/reason, FHIR-20605 for intent immutability/granularity, and FHIR-32487 for workflow element ordering, explains later source details and is represented separately.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source contains 21 MedicationRequest workflow Request mappings and narrative links to Workflow Request and Request pattern guidance, so adding redundant historical prose or reopening later per-element differences would not change implementer understanding for this seed.
